text:
Ana: FYI seeing recurrent timeouts on a 4-node TP run once microbatches > 8. Ranks 2/3 drop in the middle of the all-reduce window, job retries then pauses.
ci-bot: Incident alert: job redwood-tp-prod (run-6821) failed 3 times within 15m — auto-retry paused.
Mike: ugh. can you paste the minimal stderr and repro steps? can we repro in staging?
Ana: pasted minimal stderr snippet from the crash: 
```
2024-11-15T12:03:21Z Rank 2: NCCL ERROR: unhandled system error
    at ncclAllReduce(...)
    ...
    timeout waiting for response from rank 3
```
Sophie: I ran a perf capture on staging with --sample-n 30. Top-level summary:
```
allreduce_wait_ms: mean=42.1 p95=312 p99=1240
kernel_compute_ms: mean=3.2 p95=6.8
comm_overlap_gain_ms: -18.3  # negative = comm didn’t overlap with compute
kv_cache_miss_rate: rank skew: rank2=0.27 rank3=0.04
```
Sophie: note the huge p99 on allreduce and the kvcache_miss skew between ranks. looks like synchronization is waiting on a rank that’s doing extra work/evicting.
Devon: quick hypothesis: kernel-selector is choosing a fused int8 kernel on some ranks that increases single-kernel runtime and prevents async stream progress, so the expected comm/compute overlap disappears. combined with KV cache refill on token 0 for some microbatches (mempressure) -> page faults -> rank lag.
Mike: repro steps I used on staging: 
```bash
export RW_NUM_NODES=4
export RW_MICROBATCHES=12
./run_tp.sh --chunks 8 --profile --capture nccl,kv,metrics
```
Mike: attaching the short pprof-ish flame sample I grabbed (trimmed):
```
flame: top frames:
  ncclAllReduce (blocked) 1200ms
  fused_matmul_int8_kernel 280ms
  kv_cache_refill 92ms (rank2 only)
```
Sophie: quick experiment toggling RW_COMM_OVERLAP=1 reduced p99 by ~600ms but bumped mean by ~10ms. logs show ncclAllReduce start delayed when kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.2 on any rank.
Ana: ok — two levers to try: 1) make kernel selection prefer consistent (slightly slower) kernels across ranks to avoid stragglers; 2) avoid evicting KV entries during early token processing (raise headroom or prefetch).
Devon: small, low-risk patch to kernel selector (pseudodiff):
```diff
- if (stat == "best_latency") select_fused();
+ // prefer stability across ranks when memory headroom is low to preserve overlap
+ if (stat == "best_latency" && est_mem_headroom > 0.15) select_fused();
+ else select_stable();
```
Devon: add a metric 'kvcache_miss_skew' to help alert on this pattern.
Mike: ran Devon's change on staging for 1h with RW_MICROBATCHES=12 and RW_COMM_OVERLAP=1. Results: 4/4 runs stable, no signal loss, p99 allreduce down ~550ms compared to baseline. :tada:
Ana: awesome. Mike — can you open a PR with the selector change + the kvcache_miss_skew metric + a regression test that simulates a KV miss skew across ranks? assign to Devon for review.
Mike: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/PR-3145 (includes test harness simulating staggered kv misses).
Ana: thanks. next actions: monitor weekend production runs, add dashboard panel for kvcache_miss_skew, and triage if skew > 0.15.
Ana: leaving this thread here, will follow up in the postmortem if anything new pops up. :white_check_mark:
